column122: Imagine you need the following tests and a health professional has confirmed they are suitable. Package: Basic Wellness Panel. Included tests: Full Blood Count (checks for anaemia, infection, and blood disorders); Fasting Blood Glucose (measures blood sugar); Lipid Profile (measures cholesterol and triglycerides); Liver Function Test (assesses liver health); Kidney Function Test (assesses kidney health). Collection: At a laboratory or collection centre in Lagos or FCT Abuja. Expected results: Within 48 hours of sample collection. Results explanation: A PDF report with all test values and reference ranges. No doctor consultation is included. An interpretation service is available separately. Total price: NGN ${offer_price}, including all laboratory fees and applicable taxes. Payment: Online payment by card or bank transfer, or payment at the laboratory. Cancellation or refund terms: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before scheduled collection. Refunds processed within 5 working days. This is a research example, not an offer to purchase today.
